n0.text: Ah, Fennel! Welcome to my kitchen. Mind the cauldron, it is bubbling with opinions today.

n1.text: Listen, cooking is the soul of fighting. A Smoked Gouda glaze makes your fire hotter. A sprig of thyme in your whey makes it gust. Mix and match at the cauldron!

n2.text: Bring me a rare cheese and I'll make you something that would make a rat weep with joy. Or just weep. They weep easily.

q.text: Shall I tell you a kitchen secret?

choices.text: No, I'll find out the hard way.

s.text: Never cook angry. Angry cheese gets grainy. Also: butter. When in doubt, more butter.

no.text: Ha! A true chef. Splash first, ask questions later.
